title: Page blocks: islands and buttons inside Markus containers (cards, columns)
description: ::island and ::button are line-level directives handled before Markus, so a line inside a ':::card' or ':::column' container splits the container into two segments and breaks it. Tactus-web (PPY-ef5843) has 15 islands and 5 button rows inside cards and columns. Track Markus container depth; inside a container replace the directive with a one-line placeholder paragraph and swap the HTML in after conversion.
